name: Path Dimension / Radon Number (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm P(2^{[n]})=n$ while its Radon number is $\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, the Radon number is $n$ while $\mathrm P(\mathcal S_n)=1$.
proof: The Full Cube and Singleton value formulae yield unbounded gaps in both directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Path Dimension and Radon Number of the Full Cube and Singletons.
